newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was quiet late Monday. There were no sales of slaughter steers or heifers confirmed at the close.

Inquiry was moderate, demand was light. Sales confirmed for the week to date on 1,500 head of previously contracted or formulated cattle. Monday asking prices 70.00-71.00, bids 67.00; last sales Thursday April 17 at 68.00. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
